hero.eyebrow: Canadian software studio · Built by Brazilian engineers
hero.title: Software that adapts
hero.titleAccent: to how your business actually works.
hero.subtitle: We embed into your operation, learn the real workflow, and build the systems that let your company keep producing — with or without you in the room.

manifesto.title: We don't sell software off the shelf.
manifesto.lead: Most software houses arrive with a product looking for a problem. We do the opposite: we walk into your company, sit next to your team, and learn the operation before writing a single line of code.
paragraphs: Adapto is a software studio focused on evolving how businesses operate through technology. We eliminate manual tasks and give you real control — from inventory to team management — so your company keeps growing even when you step away.
The change starts from the inside. We adapt to your culture, your process, your people. The result is software that fits like it was always there.

inside.title: From the inside out
inside.description: We learn your operation before we propose a solution. The brief is what you tell us; the answer comes from what we see.

process.title: Process over product
process.description: Your workflow is the spec. We don't reshape your team to fit a tool — we shape the tool to fit your team.

partnership.title: Long-term partnership
partnership.description: We ship, we stay. Adapto sticks around to evolve the system as your business grows.

services.title: Anything that removes friction from your day.
services.subtitle: If it's a system, an automation, or a dashboard — and it makes the operation lighter — we can build it.

custom.title: Custom systems
custom.description: ERPs, CRMs, internal tools and full applications designed around the exact way your team works.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: We map the repetitive work — reports, approvals, data entry — and replace it with quiet automations that run while you sleep.

dashboards.title: Dashboards & visibility
dashboards.description: Real-time views of what matters: sales, stock, operations, people. Decisions stop relying on gut feeling.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the tools you already use — accounting, e-commerce, logistics, payments — into one consistent operation.

differentials.title: We're not a freelancer. We're not a generic agency.
differentials.subtitle: We're the engineering team that becomes part of your company for as long as you need us.

contrast.themEmbedded: Drop a quote, disappear until the demo, send a Slack invite at launch.
contrast.themDiagnostic: Start coding from the first call. Reshape scope mid-sprint.
contrast.themHonest: Hide slippage behind status emojis. Surprise you with a launch delay.
contrast.themLasting: Hand over a black-box codebase nobody on your side can read.

embedded.title: Embedded with your team
embedded.description: We treat your operation like our own. Daily contact, shared rituals, full transparency on what's being built and why.

diagnostic.title: Diagnosis first, code second
diagnostic.description: Every project starts with a discovery — written down, agreed on, signed off. No code until the problem is real and the scope is clear.

honest.title: Honest delivery
honest.description: Weekly updates, working software every sprint, and a fixed scope that respects your budget. If something slips, you hear it from us first.

lasting.title: Built to last
lasting.description: Clean architecture, documented code and a handover that lets you keep the system running long after we ship.

process.title: Five phases. No magic.
process.subtitle: A repeatable, transparent process from first call to long-term partnership.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: We meet your team, map the pain, document the problem and define the goal — before anyone talks about technology.

modeling.title: Modeling
modeling.description: Requirements, architecture, wireframes and a realistic roadmap. You approve every assumption before we start.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Agile builds in short cycles. You see working software every few days, with code review, tests and clean releases.

control.title: Quality & control
control.description: Continuous testing, scope tracking and weekly status. Risks are flagged early; nothing surprises us at launch.

delivery.title: Delivery & beyond
delivery.description: Final deploy, technical and user documentation, training, and a warranty period. Then ongoing support if you want it.

work.title: A few of the operations we've reshaped.
work.subtitle: Custom builds for retail, services, logistics and operations teams.
work.empty: Cases coming soon — currently building with our first cohort of clients.

contact.title: Bring us the problem. We'll bring the questions.
contact.subtitle: Book a 30-minute call. We'll listen, ask, and tell you honestly whether we're the right team for the job.
